note: QSL-2743. Row-contract vectors for FR-830 (selected model-union witness rows). They reuse the declarations of domain-package-acme-shapes.json (Shape Flag(Boolean)/Empty/Both(Pair); List Nil/Cons(Cell); Cell(Integer, List); Nest(Pair, Shape); Holder(pair, shape, pairs)) and the package fixtures/positive-model-tuple-union.json as read by model-tuple-union-vectors.json, and do not restate the declaration semantics (FR-322 'Tuple value types and payload-bearing variant types', FR-440, FR-441). Encodings are the producer sidecar's existing ones, written as JSON values: `structural_node` and each payload `node` are the serde form of CheckedNodeId, which is exactly the `node_id` object of the node in the package; `type_handle`, `settled_key`, `member.declaration` and the composite and unit `node` of `original_type` are OriginalNodeKey values (nested at most 32 keys); `original_type` is a complete OriginalValueType; `original_case` is the DeclarationKey {package, node} of the selected document's variant. The fixture is symbolic: node ids are written here and no vector derives an original key from a name. For model declarations the original key and the emitted node id are written alike because they coincide today; their roles stay distinct and no vector requires the equality. SIDE INPUTS: a case's `witnesses` carries the rows the join reads for the payload nodes: `declarations` rows in the identity file's `declarations` encoding (form record_value_type or declared_unit; exact_identity.value a node reference or a declared UnitId) and `tuples` rows with the members of SelectedTupleDeclarationRow {structural_node, selected_document, original_identity, node_key}; the identity file carries no member for selected model tuples today, so `tuples` is an in-memory adapter input and its absence on the bytes-only route is a named design blocker (FR-830 Status). HOW A CASE IS BUILT: a case builds its input from its `base` (or, for a positive, from the package and projection named here) with, in order, its `extensions` (named patch sets under `extensions`, each with a `document_patch` over the `domain_package` projection of model-tuple-union-vectors.json, a `package_patch` over the package fixture and optional `witnesses`), then its own `document_patch` and `package_patch`, then `witnesses_patch` over the witnesses (the witnesses of the extensions, in extension order, then the case's own, concatenated member by member), then `patch` over `model_unions`; a refusal inherits its base's `scope`, extensions, patches and witnesses and replaces them only with its own `scope_override`. Expected results are typed refusals: `code` is a native ExactTypeProjectionErrorCode spelling (unavailable_identity_witness, incomplete_identity_witness, mismatched_identity_witness, conflicting_identity_witness, unknown_node, exhausted_work, exhausted_storage) or `malformed` for the identity-file reader's closed-format refusal; `locus.pointer` is the sidecar member and the structural locus is the row's `structural_node` (or the payload `node` named by the pointer). Budget cases state relations to a baseline measured on the same input, not static totals, because the native work and storage policy fixes each charge. Published inputs and expected results only: no reader implements FR-830, every patch below is unread, and nothing here is qualified by running it.

E-unit.description: A model-owned dimension Time and unit ms, and Shape gains Span(ms). Authored as patches over the projection and the package; a full FCD document extension of domain-package-acme-shapes.json (FCD FR-146 dimensions and units members) is a prerequisite to executing it.

E-records.description: Records Wrapper(shape: Shape, flag: Boolean), Node(next: Link) and Orphan(n: Integer), and the union Link{End, More(Node)}, which makes Node and Link mutually recursive. Authored as patches; the full document extension is a prerequisite to executing it.

positive.note: Authored order Flag, Empty, Both is carried canonically as Both, Empty, Flag with positions 2, 1, 0; rows sort List before Shape. Pair and Cell are tuples witnessed by their SelectedTupleDeclarationRow; Boolean is a native scalar node and needs no witness.
Shape reaches Boolean and Pair; Pair reaches Boolean and Integer; List is not reached.
The List row is wrong but is not in the reached closure, so it is neither inspected, charged nor retained; MUW-R-35 refuses the same rows under full scope.
List reaches Cell; Cell reaches Integer and List; the visited List is not expanded again.
Nest is a tuple and needs no row; its Shape position makes Shape reached.

The Holder object type adds a model/object_type node by the form of Switch in fixtures/positive-state-transition.json. Its fields pair, shape and pairs reach Pair, Shape and Pair (3 edges); Pair adds 2 and Shape adds 2.
model-tuple-union-vectors.json TK-08: Shape.Flag's payloadType is Clock. The row keeps the authored payload with no node and no original_type; Empty stays nullary.
List gains a nullary Empty beside Shape.Empty; the two cases are two members with distinct declarations and distinct original cases.
Shape gains Tail(List). The payload's composite key is List's own row's type_handle, the model-union witness of the payload node.
Every join passes with producer keys the reader cannot authenticate: the rows are admitted and the keys returned byte for byte. Admission is not a claim of provenance.
Span(ms): the payload node is the model-owned unit node, the original type is a quantity of the declared unit, and the unit key equals the declared_unit declaration row's key.
Wrapper reaches Shape and Boolean (2); Shape adds 2 and Pair adds 2. Only Shape needs a row.
Node reaches Link and Link's More reaches Node, which is not expanded again. Link's payload original type is the composite of the Node record's declaration witness.
Orphan, Wrapper and Node are not reached from Shape and have no declaration witness; they are neither required nor inspected.

probes.records: the baseline delta {work: W, storage: S} and the returned rows

probes.asserts: the same rows and a delta equal to the baseline's
amount is the full attempted charge of the baseline's last work charge, the locus is that charge's row index and form, consumed work excludes the denied charge, and no rows are returned
amount is the full attempted charge of the baseline's last storage charge, charged before its reserve, clone or insertion, and no rows are returned
the first work charge is the join's own preflight or first row, and the configured bound reported is 0
nothing is retained and the configured bound reported is 0

probes.records: the baseline delta, which includes the closure edges

probes.limits: {work: E-1, storage: ample} where E is the number of work charges the closure takes
probes.asserts: the denial falls on a closure edge before any row is read

probes.limits: ample, one budget for both joins
probes.asserts: after the second join the cumulative consumption is the sum of the two baselines, the second join's delta equals its own baseline, and no allowance is created or restored between them
cumulative consumption keeps every charge admitted before the refusal, there is no success delta and no rows are returned
